item.title: Blake Lively, Justin Baldoni settlement reportedly ends with no money as expert calls it ‘complete disaster’
item.description: No money was reportedly exchanged in the Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni settlement, ending their bitter legal fight over "It Ends With Us" claims.

item.title: Tanner Horner sentenced to death for kidnapping and killing 7-year-old girl during FedEx delivery
item.description: Former FedEx driver Tanner Horner received the death penalty from a Tarrant County jury for the kidnapping and murder of 7-year-old Athena Strand.
